draft.originalRequest: Six-week hybrid template showing strength, supersets, running intervals, assessment pace methods, and Metcon scoring. Coach review required.

program.name: Six-Week Hybrid Foundation
program.description: Example contract document. Review and individualize before use.
program.coachNotes: Training days are Monday and Thursday. Confirm athlete readiness and equipment.
program.progressionInstructions: Increase only after coach review. Assessment-based paces are estimates, never measured VO2max.

sessions.name: Monday · Strength + AMRAP
sessions.coachNotes: Keep 1–3 reps in reserve unless the coach changes the target.

exercises.notes: Two loading blocks are examples; set totals equal 5.
exercises.progressionInstructions: Week 1: coach reviews actual completed reps and RPE before adjusting.
If no qualifying history exists, coach sets the first target.

blocks.name: A1/A2 superset
blocks.supersetNotes: Alternate bench and rows; stop if technique degrades.

sessions.name: Thursday · Squat + Run Intervals
sessions.coachNotes: Running pace is derived only when the athlete has qualifying assessment evidence.

exercises.progressionInstructions: Week 1: percentage changes by coach review.

exercises.notes: Do not treat assessment pace as a measured VO2max.
exercises.progressionInstructions: Coach reviews interval completion and fatigue before progressing.
